summary.summary_zh: 腾讯微信视觉团队（WeChat Vision）发布 WeVisOne-VL-2B，一个基于 Qwen3-VL 构建的统一视觉语言模型。它通过结构化下一 token 预测加仅 9.5M 参数的轻量像素解码器，将对象级感知（开放词汇检测、指代定位、目标计数、点定位、OCR）与像素级感知（指代分割、alpha 抠图）统一在单一模型中。相比基础模型 Qwen3-VL，新增专用坐标 token（<0>..<1000>）、<OBJ> 实例 token、Box-Guided Query Decoder 与 FullCanvasAlphaCascadeHead 等像素级预测组件，可直接输出全分辨率连续 alpha 抠图。模型以 Apache 2.0 许可开源，面向视觉定位与抠图研究，暂不支持显式 CoT 推理和多轮视频感知。

innovations.title: 对象级与像素级感知统一
innovations.detail: 以结构化下一 token 预测承载对象级任务（检测/指代定位/计数/指向/OCR），配合仅 9.5M 参数（mask_decoder.pt，9,511,460 参数）的轻量像素解码器实现像素级任务（指代分割、alpha 抠图）

innovations.title: Box-Guided Query Decoder 与级联抠图头
innovations.detail: 6 个可变形交叉注意力块，从 <OBJ> 隐状态初始化并使用 Fourier 编码的框先验；FullCanvasAlphaCascadeHead 在 S/4、S/2、S/1 逐级精化，输出 stride 1 的全分辨率连续 alpha 抠图

innovations.title: 结构化输出 token 设计
innovations.detail: 使用专用坐标 token（<0>..<1000>）表示归一化框与点，查询目标不存在时返回 None，每个预测框后输出实例 token <OBJ>（token ID 152678）；为推理效率直接生成结构化输出而不做显式 CoT 推理

summary.progress_note: 在 Qwen3-VL 基座上首次将对象级与像素级感知统一进单一 2B 模型，以轻量像素解码器扩展了抠图等像素级能力

training.data_mix: 20T token rigorously filtered corpus built via Hunyuan-TurboS data curation pipeline, with enhanced STEM-focused data curation including 250B tokens of high-quality STEM corpus; refined knowledge labeling system and multi-dimensional difficulty grading framework
pretrain_innovations: Fine-grained MoE architecture: 1 shared expert + 64 fine-grained experts with 8 activated (80B total / 13B active parameters)
Enhanced STEM data acquisition and cleaning (250B high-quality STEM tokens)
Three-stage pre-training: foundation training (20T tokens), fast annealing (300B tokens), long-context training to 256K
NTK-aware positional encoding for context extension to 32K and 256K (alpha 50/1000)
Multi-dimensional difficulty grading framework for efficient corpus selection
posttrain_innovations: Reasoning-oriented SFT with high-quality long-CoT data followed by targeted RL optimization
General SFT across domain-specific tasks followed by generalized RL for instruction-following
Dual-CoT framework with fast-thinking and slow-thinking modes dynamically adjusting reasoning depth
